class.name: WorldGround
class.brief_description: The ground contract: the deformable ground's surface, soil and what lies on it.
class.description: Read it through [method WorldContracts.get_ground]. The provider is the active [GroundSurface3D]; with none, every query returns its default (firm ground, nothing on it, the height from the first physics surface under the point). A test sets a stub with [method WorldContracts.set_ground]: a script extending this class that overrides the virtual methods it needs; the rest fall back to the real ground. See docs/ideas/world-contracts.md.

method.name: add_runoff_load
method.description: Loose material washed off the ground at [param position] since the caller's last call, in kg of mineral (soil) and of ash and char. The runoff producer ([code]WeatherRunoff3D[/code]) carries it down its drainage and hands it to [method WorldWater.add_sediment] where the flow reaches a river or lake. Dropped when there is no runoff producer.

method.name: albedo_at
method.description: The ground as drawn at [param position], a few metres' mean: linear rgb, and in alpha how much of it is known (1 where a ground colour answers; the snow's cover alone where no colour does; 0 nothing). The terrain material's layer colours (TerrainMaterial3D, by its generator's geology and slope), darkened by the weather's surface wetness by the layers' porosity, under the snowpack ([method WorldSnow.albedo_at]). Readers blend their own setting toward rgb by alpha, as PhysXFlow3D does for the light the ground sends up into gas.

method.name: blown_sand_at
method.description: How much of the sand there the wind moves now, 0 to 1: dry sand out of shelter. Default 0.

method.name: coarse_cover_at
method.description: The share of the ground (0..1) covered by coarse grains at [param position]: x pebbles, y gravel, z fine grains, from the [RockField3D] cover maps (the largest any field reports; 0 with none). A gravel lag armours the sand under it, so blown sand and wind ripples read pebble + gravel.

method.name: dent_at
method.description: How far the ground is pressed down at [param position] (ruts, prints), in metres. Default 0.

method.name: frost_at
method.description: The frozen ground: the thawed layer on top (m), the frost's depth (m) and how weakened a thaw has left it (0 to 1). Default zero.

method.name: has_provider
method.description: [code]true[/code] when a ground is live.

method.name: has_runoff
method.description: Whether a runoff producer (or a script stub) takes [method add_runoff_load].

method.name: height_at
method.description: The ground's deformed surface under [param position], in metres. With no ground, the first physics surface under the point, else -INF.

method.name: ice_at
method.description: Ice on standing water: its thickness (m) and the share broken into plates. Default zero.

method.name: known_height_at
method.description: The deformed ground surface's height under [param position] (m) as the ground's producer (or a stub) knows it, or [code]NAN[/code] where none does. Unlike [method height_at] it never falls back to a physics ray from far above, which would find roofs and upper floors; [FootPlacementModifier3D] reads it before its own short ray.

method.name: mud_depth_at
method.description: The depth of soft slurry over firmer soil, in metres. Default 0.

method.name: needle_ice_at
method.description: Needle ice: its height (m) and the loose crumbs its thaw left (0 to 1). Default zero.

method.name: has_recess
method.description: Whether a recess producer is registered or a stub overrides [method _recess_at]. Without one the drawn face is unchanged.

method.name: notify_recess_changed
method.description: Called by a recess producer when its recess changes within [param box] (world space): it came or went, or its pillars' settings changed. Emits [signal recess_changed].

method.name: notify_relief_changed
method.description: Called by a relief producer when the relief over [param area] (world xz) changes: its heights streamed in at full resolution, its relief settings changed, or it came or went. Emits [signal relief_changed].

method.name: recess_at
method.description: The cliff kit's recess at [param position], a point of the drawn, unrecessed face (world space): x how far the face steps back (m, 0 or more) along its horizontal outward normal to stand behind the rock pillar there, y the share (0..1: 1 where the pillar's front covers the point, fading to 0 within the last 0.5 m of its outline where no neighbouring pillar continues the wall). The drawn relief mesh moves its vertices back by x times y, so the pillars are the visible wall (terrain sunk under cliff pieces, as in Far Cry 5's world generation); collision is left alone, the pillars carry their own. The deepest of all producers (RockField3D) answers. (0, 0) with none. Thread-safe.

method.name: recess_vector_at
method.description: The cliff kit's recess at [param position] as a world offset: x y z what the drawn face adds to the point (horizontal, along the pillar's own outward normal, depth times share), w the share. Prefer it to [method recess_at] with the face's own normal: on a fluted face the flanks' normals point sideways, and a step along them leaves the ridges standing in front of the pillars. Zero with no producer. Thread-safe.

method.name: relief_at
method.description: The drawn ground's relief over the heightfield at [param position]'s xz: x the height to add to the heightfield's (m; Landscape3D's cliff and bank relief push the surface out along the slope's horizontal normal, so about the push times the slope's tangent here), y its share (0..1). Plants, rocks and ground detail placed on the heightfield add x so they sit on the ground as drawn. GPU placers read the global [code]terrain_relief_map[/code] (R height m, G share) over [code]terrain_relief_rect[/code]; the map leaves out the terracettes' steps (3 m apart, finer than its texels), which a placer adds at each root with [code]wc_terracette_step[/code]. [param steps] false leaves them out here too, for a placer that bakes heights at texel centres and adds the steps at each root (a script override of [method _relief_at] ignores it) ([method WorldContracts.terracette_shader_code]; share [code]terrain_bank_relief.y[/code] times [code]wc_terracette_soil[/code] of the geology). (0, 0) with no relief producer. [param recess] false leaves out the cliff kit's recess ([method recess_at]), for the kit itself, which is fitted to the unrecessed face.

method.name: rim_at
method.description: How far the ground is raised at [param position] (berms, laid soil), in metres. Default 0.

method.name: ripple_at
method.description: The wind ripples' height about their mean, in metres. Default 0.

method.name: runoff_at
method.description: Water running over the ground: its depth (m) and speed (m/s). Default zero.

method.name: rut_guidance_at
method.description: Ruts under a tyre at [param contact]: the cross slope of the ground's deformation along [param lateral] (rising towards it), and the rut wall's height beside the tread on its -[param lateral] and +[param lateral] sides (m), for a tread [param half_width] m either side. Default zero.

method.name: sand_at
method.description: Loose sand's share of the ground's top, 0 to 1. Default 0.

method.name: soil_at
method.description: The soil: [code]soft[/code] (false for firm ground, rock or no soil), [code]cohesion[/code] (kPa), [code]friction_angle[/code] (degrees) and [code]stickiness[/code] (0 to 1, how wet clay clings). Default firm.

method.name: standing_water_at
method.description: Water standing on the ground (ruts, prints, puddles), in metres. Default 0.

method.name: stones_near
method.description: The stones standing above the ground in the world xz [param rect], 7 floats each: x, z, ground height, top height, the footprint's half axes x and z (world metres) and its yaw (radians about +y, as SnowSurface3D.set_stone_list takes them), from every stone field ([RockField3D]: its laid cells, the ground detail included). Only stones whose top stands above their ground, for readers that shape what lies round them (the snowpack's melt moats and lee drifts). Empty with no stone field.

method.name: track_mud
method.description: Leaves [param depth] metres of mud film carried by a body on the ground at [param position] over [param radius] metres; [param wet] is its water share (0..1). [param print]: x 1 for a tyre, 2 for a sole (0: a thrown lump), y the yaw, z and w the print's length and width. Returns the volume laid, m3 (0 with no provider). GroundSurface3D provides it.

signal.name: debris_flow
signal.description: A post-fire debris flow started on the runoff's drainage (WeatherRunoff3D), for the ground and physics to run it; [param event] as [signal WeatherRunoff3D.debris_flow] gives it.

signal.name: recess_changed
signal.description: The cliff kit's recess changed within [param box] (world space): the drawn relief there is built again.

signal.name: relief_changed
signal.description: The drawn relief over [param area] (world xz) changed: placers that set things at the heightfield plus [method relief_at] lay what sits there again (RockField3D's ground detail does).
